iti109:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso nadiyā sotena ovuyheyya piyarūpasātarūpena
iti109:2.2: tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito disvā evaṃ vadeyya
iti109:2.3: kiñcāpi kho tvaṃ ambho purisa nadiyā sotena ovuyhasi piyarūpasātarūpena atthi cettha heṭṭhā rahado saūmī sāvaṭṭo sagaho sarakkhaso yaṃ tvaṃ ambho purisa rahadaṃ pāpuṇitvā maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
iti109:2.4: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso tassa purisassa saddaṃ sutvā hatthehi ca pādehi ca paṭisotaṃ vāyameyya.
iti109:3.1: upamā kho me ayaṃ bhikkhave katā atthassa viññāpanāya.
iti109:3.3: nadiyā sotenāti kho bhikkhave taṇhāyetaṃ adhivacanaṃ
iti109:4.1: piyarūpasātarūpenāti kho bhikkhave channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ
iti109:5.1: heṭṭhā rahadoti kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ
iti109:7.1: sāvaṭṭoti kho bhikkhave pañcannetaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ
iti109:8.1: sagaho sarakkhasoti kho bhikkhave mātugāmassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ
iti109:10.1: hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyāmoti kho bhikkhave viriyārambhassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ
iti109:11.1: cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhitoti kho bhikkhave tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti.
